page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, limiting its utility for workloads requiring hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With dedicated CPU allocation and a high clock speed of 3.3 GHz, the instance offers predictable compute performance for large-scale deployments. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represents a balanced hardware profile, positioning it as a general-purpose resource. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs reduces the hardware overhead, making it a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy tasks that rely on external storage. Suitable workloads include enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business logic processing.
